title: SignedDocumentWrapperV1
description: Detached signature wrapper shared by the setup descriptor, the release catalog and the release manifest. A signature that travels inside the bytes it covers cannot be checked without first deciding which bytes to strip, so the signature sits outside: the contract object rides as `document`, and `signature.value` covers that object's canonical JSON (RFC 8785). The document keeps the exact bytes its own schema describes, which is what lets one validator check both a fetched document and a fixture. Added in I0-C2 after Wave 1 found the frozen envelopes had no place to put a signature.

document.description: The signed contract object, verified against its own schema separately. The wrapper deliberately says nothing about its shape so one wrapper serves every document kind.

keyId.description: Names which trusted key signed. An unknown key ID is refused rather than verified against whichever key happens to be on hand.

algorithm.description: Ed25519 only. A single accepted value means a producer cannot negotiate the verifier down to something weaker.

value.description: Base64 detached signature over the canonical JSON of `document`.
